text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: Orfèvre-san is arriving on set!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Today's shoot will take place on this 
course. We look forward to working with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Retainer Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Lady Orfèvre, allow us to tend 
to your hair.

text_block_list.name: Retainer Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Please permit me to adjust the hem of your 
jacket a little more...!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Proceed.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Um, by the way, who might these people 
be?

text_block_list.name: Retainer Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
We are retainers of Lady Orfèvre. Pay us 
no mind.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...? Then let me explain the theme 
of this special feature once more!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
The theme is: "The Golden Overlord 
Charging Forth, Backed by the Blazing 
Sun"!!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
We'd like Orfèvre-san to run just like in 
an actual race while we capture the 
photos!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —Granted. Prepare at once.

text_block_list.name: Retainer Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
We must ensure her flowing locks look 
magnificent on camera. Combing through the 
tips a bit more—

text_block_list.name: Retainer Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the chain at her waist is slightly 
smudged...! I will polish it right away, 
so it shines in the sun...!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Enough. Do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew
text_block_list.text:
All preparations ready!! Let us begin the 
shoot right away—
(Rumble rumble rumble... CRRRRRAAAACK!!)
(POOOOOUUUUURRRRR!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
No way, rain?! The forecast said 
sunny...!!

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, bad bad bad!! Wait, evacuate the 
equipment!! It'll get soaked!!

text_block_list.name: Retainer Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Orfèvre! Quickly, under the shelter!! 
Ahhh, your outfit and hair will be 
ruined...!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
T-This can't be... The radiant figure of 
the Overlord against the sun... We 
carefully picked the location and date 
just for that... and now it's all 
ruined...

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —Silence, commoners!!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
You there. Ready your camera. A smartphone 
will do.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew
text_block_list.text: Y-Y-Yes, ma'am! Huh?! Wait, um—

text_block_list.name: Retainer Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Lady Orfèvre!? Please wait, what are you—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Nothing stands in the path of Our 
hegemony.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAH!!

—Gouging through the heavy, drenched turf. 
Kicking up mud, her untamed soul charges 
ferociously.

Across the rain-swept turf, her dazzling, 
valiant figure dyes everything in 
brilliant gold—

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"—None... not even the heavens, can 
obstruct the King's path, or that golden 
brilliance"...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah... this is it... This is the very 
essence we were meant to convey...

The magazine featuring Orfèvre was finally 
released. The cover photo—capturing her 
sprinting through the torrential 
downpour—became a massive sensation across 
the public.

text_block_list.name: New Disciple Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Lady Orfèvre! I saw the magazine! I've 
completely become a devoted fan—

text_block_list.name: Retainer Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Restrain yourself! A true retainer does 
not waste Lady Orfèvre's precious time—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Peace. You there—your loyalty is accepted. 
Serve Us well.

text_block_list.name: New Disciple Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—!! Yes! Please allow me to serve you for 
all eternity!!

More and more fans—or rather, students 
proclaiming to be her retainers—seem to be 
gathering around Orfèvre. I was left in 
absolute awe of her immense charisma.

Even though it was just standard training 
hours, an unusually large crowd had 
gathered today. The reason—Orfèvre was 
about to run.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Must be the magazine's doing. Read it 
myself, and hearing how that shoot went 
down... she really is a tyrant.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Holding her reins must be near 
impossible... yet even so, one can't help 
but dream of training her.

Every Trainer in the stands kept their 
eyes glued to her. Her peerless charisma 
and overwhelming prowess naturally 
captivated everyone around.
